'''Delas Fotrin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who served in the [[Thaereian military]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Fotrin became a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] in the Thaereian military. However, while flying a [[G-59 Cannibalizer]] above the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]] as a part of a routine patrol, he encountered an atmospheric disturbance and crash-landed. However, his ship punctuated the crust of Tilnes and plummeted down, landing in a mineshaft deep beneath the surface. Fotrin was unable to extricate himself and could not activate his [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] because doing so would go against [[Order 1138]]. He recorded a short [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] and then died soon afterwards.

Roughly ten years later, in about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the ship and Fotrin's body were discovered by the [[Heroes of Cularin]].
